dcep_info.dcep_description: Per-parameter and aggregate confidence metrics for all SMAD statistical scaling evaluations. Quantifies how well the source database supports each estimate.
Input: Total system mass wet including margins
total payload mass. based on statistics.

mass_payload.n_source_points: 14 Number of source data points (per parameter) - Count of original (non-interpolated) data points in the scaling CSV for this parameter. Used in the n_factor penalty: n_factor=min(1,(n-1)/4). Ref: Stone (1974), JRSS-B 36(2):111.
mass_payload.regime: interpolation Scaling regime (per parameter) - interpolation: query x is within the source data range. extrapolation: query x is outside the source data range. Ref: Draper & Smith, Applied Regression Analysis, 3rd ed., Wiley 1998, s3.8.
mass_payload.gap_fraction: 0.066164 Normalised gap fraction (per parameter) - Span of the bracketing source-data interval (or extrapolation extent) divided by the total source data range. 0=query is at a data point, 1=maximally far from all source points.
mass_payload.score: 0.93384 Scaling confidence score (per parameter) - Confidence score in [0,1] for a single scaling evaluation. Interpolation: n_factor*(1-gap_fraction), clamped [0.30,1.00]. Extrapolation: 0.30*(1-extrap_fraction), max 0.30.
mass_payload.label: high Confidence label (per parameter) - high (score 0.70 and above), medium (score 0.40 to 0.70), or low (score below 0.40). Traffic-light colour scheme as requested by REQ-MOST-FUNC-0140.

power_ttc.gap_fraction: 0.28069 Normalised gap fraction (per parameter) - Span of the bracketing source-data interval (or extrapolation extent) divided by the total source data range. 0=query is at a data point, 1=maximally far from all source points.
power_ttc.score: 0.71931 Scaling confidence score (per parameter) - Confidence score in [0,1] for a single scaling evaluation. Interpolation: n_factor*(1-gap_fraction), clamped [0.30,1.00]. Extrapolation: 0.30*(1-extrap_fraction), max 0.30.
power_ttc.label: high Confidence label (per parameter) - high (score 0.70 and above), medium (score 0.40 to 0.70), or low (score below 0.40). Traffic-light colour scheme as requested by REQ-MOST-FUNC-0140.

scaling_quality.mass_score: 0.93384 Mass scaling confidence score - Minimum confidence score over all SMAD mass-fraction scaling parameters (mass_payload through mass_other).
scaling_quality.power_score: 0.71931 Power scaling confidence score - Minimum confidence score over all SMAD power-fraction scaling parameters (power_payload through propulsion_power).
scaling_quality.total_score: 0.71931 Total scaling confidence score - Aggregate confidence score in [0,1] derived as the minimum over all mass and power scaling parameters. Score 0.70 and above: high (green); 0.40 to 0.70: medium (yellow); below 0.40: low (red).
